title: Sausage and Kabanos Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe featuring sausage and kabanos, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the kabanos and cook for 1-2 minutes, until crispy.
Stir in the stir fry sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve with additional stir fry sauce on the side, if desired.
Note: You can also serve with steamed vegetables or rice for a complete meal.
